response.sql: SELECT AVG(t.avg_remain) AS avg_of_order_avg_remaincount, SUM(t.exec_count) AS total_executions FROM (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain, COUNT(*) AS exec_count FROM orderexecutions WHERE CAST(expirespot AS TEXT) BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY ordersmark) t

assumptions.assumption: Executions with a NULL ordersmark form their own single group and are counted like any other order. The request does not say to exclude them.
The number of executions is COUNT(*) of the rows in each group. Each row in orderexecutions is one execution.
The BETWEEN is inclusive at both ends and compares the text form of expirespot. This follows the request's 'comparing the values as text'.
